BiblicalUsage: Harpax means rapacious, a person who grabs, and the New Testament puts the extortioner on every list of those who will not inherit the kingdom. In 1 Corinthians 5:10 and 5:11 Paul tells the church not to keep company with one, in 1 Corinthians 6:10 he says extortioners shall not inherit the kingdom of God, in Luke 18:11 the Pharisee thanks God he is not one, and in Matthew 7:15 false prophets come as ravening wolves.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the Pharisee in Luke is the warning for me: he was right that he was not an extortioner, and wrong about everything else. The list is not for sorting other people, it is for examining my own hands.
